entities.name: Klaus
entities.description: Cunning, arrogant Falkenrath vampire killed by werewolf hunters.

events.summary: Klaus underestimates a group of hunters who are werewolves, who reveal their true forms and kill him.
events.quote: Klaus underestimated his adversaries and ultimately met his demise when they revealed their true forms and overpowered him.

relations.quote: Klaus, a vampire of the Falkenrath line
